name: hbp-tooling
description: Repo-level dev tooling: git hooks that gate commits and pushes

scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:frontend
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run check:backend && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run lint:frontend && pnpm run check:frontend && pnpm run test:frontend
